desc: Prove structural properties of connected components in the disjointness graph of intervals, including a criterion for when two vertices are disconnected.
Prove a bounded-induced-path theorem for co-interval graphs and enumerate canonical endpoint-order patterns of chordless paths.
Derive the shortest-path characterization for positive vertex weights from the chordless-path structure, identifying feasible intermediate interval choices.
Design an efficient preprocessing algorithm for shortest path costs between arbitrary query endpoints, avoiding explicit graph edge construction.
Determine suitable data structures for endpoint-coordinate sweeps, range minimum queries, and query answering within constraints.
Validate the derived algorithm on edge cases: universally overlapping intervals, direct disjoint pairs, duplicate intervals, nested intervals, and disconnected components.
